what: International (Global Fulfillment) duplicates of the live Gildan 5000 and Comfort Colors 1717 listings, tagged uk/ca/au, handle <source>-int, held as Shopify drafts.
deliveryProfile: All 98 sit in a Printify-managed "Printify Choice - International" profile, the Global Fulfillment pass-through card: US $4.75, UK $2.99, Germany $2.99, Canada $6.79, Australia $8.39, rest of world $10.00. Printify assigns it on publish; no rates are set by hand.
eligibility: Global Fulfillment is decided PER VARIANT (colour and size together), read from printify.com/product-catalog-service/api/v2/blueprints/<bp>/print-providers/<pp>/variants. The per-colour flag on the catalog page over-approximates badly: on Comfort Colors 1717 only 52 of 509 variants qualify and Black is the only colour eligible in every size. Building from the colour flag put 24 of these into the US-facility profile, where international buyers pay import shipping; they were re-cut and republished.
